01: Ugh, ants everywhere! I'll just step on them.
02: Wait, Yusuf! Once, one little ant saved her whole valley from a great army.
04: It was the army of Sulayman, peace be upon him. His father was Dawud, peace be upon him.
05: Allah gave him a kingdom like no other. The wind blew at his command, and he was taught the language of the birds.
06: One day his soldiers, of jinn, of men and of birds, marched in rows toward a valley of ants.
07: And one ant called out: O ants, go into your homes, so that Sulayman, peace be upon him, and his soldiers do not step on you without noticing.
08: Wait... he could understand what the ant said?
09: He smiled at her words, and he prayed: My Lord, help me to be grateful for Your favor upon me and upon my parents.
10: A great king... and the first thing he did was thank Allah.
11: Then I'll walk around them. Alhamdulillah, even for the little things!
12: That is the dua of Sulayman, peace be upon him. Let's learn it together.
